name: StockTicker
tagline: Watch your stock portfolio right on your home screen
description:
StockTicker adds a resizable widget to your home screen that shows your financial portfolio at a glance, no need to open a separate app just to check your stocks. Add the tickers you care about and see them update right where you'll actually see them.

It's a simple, focused tool for anyone who wants a quick, glanceable view of their investments.
